reviews.summary_zh: pair-programming从claude-flow flags迁ruflo pair子命令+per-turn角色状态/归档；新增6个ChatGPT federation guides、ruRE静态分析及Grok team bus模板。relay都是data，gateway签名append-only不可撤回，private ciphertext不解密，公开gateway不虚报local compliance/trust。witness明确public-commit seed只完整性，authorship必须私有seed+固定公钥；modTrust风险面扩大到MCP/agent/prompt/session/config/FS hooks。
reviews.summary_addition_en: Ruflo adds bounded federation workflows and clarifies witness authenticity and plugin trust surfaces
reviews.review_method: Read fixed before/after diffs; coalesce equal blob pairs and repeated hunks, inspect substantive workflow/inputs/output and safety boundaries of added public skills; classify removed paths, mirrors and fixtures using manifest/README-backed distribution scope. Not runtime or domain-expert certification.

distribution_scope.summary_zh: 新增 analyze-app 插件技能及 6 份 ChatGPT Federation 适配版；后者 manifest 明确复用既有意图并移除不可用工具，不作为六个全新独立能力；新增 grok agent-teams 为客户端模板。388 物理路径包含 .agents/.claude、v3 templates、多个宿主包装，目录改用明确多技能范围，避免继续原 380 的误导。
